rows.label: FIRST HALF

rows.label: ICE AGE

rows.label: INFANCY

rows.label: ORBIT PERIOD
rows.clue: The time it takes to complete one full orbit around a celestial body

rows.label: MORATORIUM
rows.clue: A legally authorized postponement before some obligation must be discharged

rows.label: YESTERDAY
rows.clue: The day immediately before today

rows.label: IDES
rows.clue: In the Roman calendar: the 15th of March or May or July or October or the 13th of any other month

rows.label: LUNAR DAY
rows.clue: The period of time taken for the moon to make one full rotation on its axis (about 27.3 sidereal days)

rows.label: NIGHT SHIFT
rows.clue: The work shift during the night (as midnight to 8 a.m.)

rows.label: MIDNIGHT
rows.clue: 12 o'clock at night

rows.label: ANNIVERSARY
rows.clue: The date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)

rows.label: HARD TIMES
rows.clue: A time of difficulty

rows.label: LEAP DAY
rows.clue: The name of the day that is added during a leap year

rows.label: COSMIC TIME
rows.clue: The time covered by the physical formation and development of the universe

rows.label: HIGH TIME

rows.label: NAME DAY
rows.clue: The feast day of a saint whose name one bears

rows.label: SILLY SEASON
rows.clue: A time usually late summer characterized by exaggerated news stories about frivolous matters for want of real news

rows.label: ETERNITY
rows.clue: Time without end

rows.label: OFFING
rows.clue: The near or foreseeable future

rows.label: HERTZ
rows.clue: The unit of frequency

rows.label: MORNING
rows.clue: The time period between dawn and noon

rows.label: HOT SPELL
rows.clue: A spell of hot weather

rows.label: YEAR
rows.clue: A period of time containing 365 (or 366) days

rows.label: FINAL PERIOD
rows.clue: The final division into which the play of a game is divided

rows.label: CLOCKING
rows.clue: The time taken to traverse a measured course

rows.label: LEISURE
rows.clue: Time available for ease and relaxation

rows.label: LUNCH PERIOD
rows.clue: The customary or habitual hour for eating lunch

rows.label: PACE
rows.clue: The rate of moving (especially walking or running)

rows.label: PICNIC
rows.clue: A day devoted to an outdoor social gathering

rows.label: FLUX
rows.clue: The rate of flow of energy or particles across a given surface

rows.label: TIME SCALE
rows.clue: An arrangement of events used as a measure of duration

rows.label: REGENCY
rows.clue: The period of time during which a regent governs

rows.label: RAG DAY
rows.clue: A day on which university students hold a rag

rows.label: MAN HOUR
rows.clue: A time unit used in industry for measuring work

rows.label: CENTENNIAL
rows.clue: The 100th anniversary (or the celebration of it)

rows.label: FEAST DAY
rows.clue: A day designated for feasting

rows.label: SUNSET
rows.clue: The time in the evening at which the sun begins to fall below the horizon

rows.label: PREHISTORY
rows.clue: The time during the development of human culture before the appearance of the written word

rows.label: OVER

rows.label: INTERLUDE
rows.clue: An intervening period or episode

rows.label: REST DAY
rows.clue: A day set aside for rest

rows.label: BANK HOLIDAY
rows.clue: Any of several weekdays when banks are closed

rows.label: RAIN DATE
rows.clue: An alternative date set for some outdoor event in case it rains on the appointed date

rows.label: TEMPO
rows.clue: (music) the speed at which a composition is to be played

rows.label: AUTUMN
rows.clue: The season when the leaves fall from the trees

rows.label: FESTIVAL
rows.clue: A day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration

rows.label: TWO WEEKS
rows.clue: A period of fourteen consecutive days

rows.label: DOG DAYS
rows.clue: The hot period between early July and early September

rows.label: LAST
rows.clue: The temporal end

rows.label: SCHOOL YEAR
rows.clue: The period of time each year when the school is open and people are studying

rows.label: CENTURY
rows.clue: A period of 100 years

rows.label: REIGN
rows.clue: A period during which something or somebody is dominant or powerful

rows.label: HISTORY
rows.clue: The aggregate of past events

rows.label: CHILDHOOD
rows.clue: The time of person's life when they are a child

rows.label: NEW MOON
rows.clue: The time at which the Moon appears as a narrow waxing crescent

rows.label: GOLDEN AGE
rows.clue: A time period when some activity or skill was at its peak

rows.label: PAST
rows.clue: The time that has elapsed

rows.label: BEAUTY SLEEP
rows.clue: Sleep before midnight

rows.label: WEEKNIGHT
rows.clue: Any night of the week except Saturday or Sunday

rows.label: NIGHT WATCH
rows.clue: A watch during the night (as from midnight to 8 a.m.)

rows.label: ELECTION DAY
rows.clue: The day appointed for an election

rows.label: ANDANTE
rows.clue: A moderately slow tempo (a walking pace)

rows.label: SCHOOL DAY
rows.clue: Any day on which school is in session

rows.label: REST PERIOD
rows.clue: A pause for relaxation

rows.label: MOMENT
rows.clue: A particular point in time

rows.label: DAY OFF
rows.clue: A day when you are not required to work

rows.label: TIME LIMIT
rows.clue: A time period within which something must be done or completed

rows.label: NANOSECOND
rows.clue: One billionth (10^-9) of a second

rows.label: THIRTIES
rows.clue: The time of life between 30 and 40

rows.label: LATENCY
rows.clue: (computer science) the time it takes for a specific block of data on a data track to rotate around to the read/write head

rows.label: FUTURE DATE
rows.clue: A particular day in the future that is specified as the time something will happen

rows.label: NIGHT
rows.clue: The time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside

rows.label: MICROSECOND
rows.clue: One millionth (10^-6) of a second

rows.label: WAIT
rows.clue: Time during which some action is awaited

rows.label: SEEK TIME
rows.clue: (computer science) the time it takes for a read/write head to move to a specific data track

rows.label: EMBOLISM
rows.clue: An insertion into a calendar

rows.label: DAY SHIFT
rows.clue: The work shift during the day (as 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.)

rows.label: SEMESTER
rows.clue: One of two divisions of an academic year

rows.label: EXPIRY
rows.clue: A coming to an end of a contract period

rows.label: MINUTE
rows.clue: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour

rows.label: SECOND
rows.clue: 1/60 of a minute

rows.label: PHASE
rows.clue: Any distinct time period in a sequence of events

rows.label: MIDDLE AGE
rows.clue: The time of life between youth and old age (e.g., between 40 and 60 years of age)

rows.label: FLOAT
rows.clue: The time interval between the deposit of a check in a bank and its payment

rows.label: TAIL END
rows.clue: The time of the last part of something

rows.label: VOTING AGE
rows.clue: The age at which a person is old enough to vote in public elections

rows.label: EARLY DAYS
rows.clue: An early period of development

rows.label: DUE DATE
rows.clue: The date on which an obligation must be repaid

rows.label: PHASE ANGLE
rows.clue: A particular point in the time of a cycle

rows.label: PINPOINT
rows.clue: A very brief moment

rows.label: DATA RATE
rows.clue: The rate at which circuits or other devices operate when handling digital information

rows.label: NEUTRON FLUX
rows.clue: The rate of flow of neutrons

rows.label: FORTIES
rows.clue: The time of life between 40 and 50

rows.label: SUMMER
rows.clue: The warmest season of the year

rows.label: RUNNING TIME
